about.label: About
about.title: Who I Am
about.bio_1: With a foundation in scientific analysis and advanced training in business strategy, I operate at the crossroads of innovation and implementation. My Bachelor's in Chemistry trained me to think in systems; my MBA and Master in Entrepreneurship taught me to build them.
about.bio_2: Over the past years, I have independently designed and deployed multiple digital platforms — from educational academies to startup MVPs — handling everything from concept and architecture to front-end development and deployment using modern technologies such as React, Supabase, and Vercel.
about.bio_3: I work in business consulting and digital marketing, collaborating with international brands and institutions including the Italian Chamber of Commerce UK (ICUK). My focus: transforming complex business requirements into scalable digital solutions.
